_comment: Perfect Ari, as a machine-readable day. This is what finally lets
plan_for_now() return something (open item #8) -- the profile IS the plan
until The Docket is wired in.
The important column is `away_ok`. Being out of frame at 09:15 is not a
failure to detect him, it is him at the gym, which is the plan working. A
dashboard that reads `absent` as drift would flag him hardest at exactly
the moments he is most on-plan. Roughly half this day is meant to happen
`modes` lists what the resolver may emit while still being on plan. Empty
means 'anything goes' -- free time is free. Blocks are half-open
[start, next_start), so they tile the day with no gaps and no overlap.
name: Perfect Ari
_grace_note: How late a block may start before drift is called. Twenty minutes is
deliberately generous: the point is to notice a block that did not happen,
not to police the clock. A tighter number turns this into a stopwatch.
